title: Gentle Chase
user: A freelancer or family business owner who wants consistent, relationship-aware follow-up for overdue invoices without handing customer data to an automated debt-collection service.

evidence.quote_or_summary: A founder says overdue chasing is manual and awkward; small businesses either rely on QuickBooks/Xero reminders, send WhatsApp manually, or let it slide to protect the relationship.
A user requests customer treatment conditional on having no unpaid recurring invoices, showing that payment status needs to feed deliberate client communication and policy.

smallest_useful_product: A local PWA with invoice amount/due date, contact preference, follow-up cadence, notes, and editable email/WhatsApp copy buttons; it never sends messages itself.
success_measure: After 60 days, pilot users record a follow-up for 85% of invoices overdue by seven days and report fewer than 10% of follow-ups were missed because they forgot.
constraints: No automatic contact or harassment features; provide jurisdiction-neutral templates only; store client notes locally and offer export/delete.
